label: RV-EV-06
command_argv:
import hashlib, importlib.util, json, re
from pathlib import Path
import yaml
root=Path.cwd()
base=root/'handoffs/evaluator_executor'
review=base/'HNA-LAYERS-REVIEW-20261116'
next_task=base/'HNA-RESEARCH-ADMISSION-20261116'
audit=json.loads((review/'evidence/RV-EV-04.stdout.log').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==sha for p,sha in audit['input_hashes'].items())
assert all(hashlib.sha256((root/x['path']).read_bytes()).hexdigest()==x['archive_sha256'] for x in audit['archives'])
contract=(next_task/'CONTRACT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
plan=yaml.safe_load((next_task/'VALIDATION_PLAN.yaml').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
acs=set(re.findall(r'^### (AC-\d{2})',contract,re.M))
assert acs=={'AC-01','AC-02','AC-03','AC-04','AC-05'}
assert set(a for c in plan['checks'] for a in c['ac'])==acs
assert plan['task_id']=='HNA-RESEARCH-ADMISSION-20261116'
assert all(c['mandatory'] and c['expected_exit_code']==0 and isinstance(c['command'],list) for c in plan['checks'])
assert 'Contract state: DRAFT_CONTRACT' in contract
current=(root/'CURRENT.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8')
assert current.count('<!-- evaluator-executor-workflow:v2.2 -->')==1
assert 'state: DRAFT_CONTRACT' in current and 'current_role: Evaluator' in current
checked=[]
for path in [review/'REVIEW.md',next_task/'CONTRACT.md',root/'handoffs/海纳分层准入_评估与下一包_20261116.md']:
 text=path.read_text(encoding='utf-8')
 for ref in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)]+)\)', text):
  if ref.startswith(('https:','http:','#')): continue
  target=(path.parent/ref.split('#')[0]).resolve()
  assert target.is_file(), (str(path),ref)
  checked.append(ref)
 assert not any(line.rstrip()!=line for line in text.splitlines())
print(json.dumps({'checked_source_hashes':len(audit['input_hashes']),'unchanged_archive_files':len(audit['archives']),'checked_local_links':len(checked),'mapped_ACs':sorted(acs),'plan_checks':len(plan['checks']),'draft_only':True,'next_package_executed':False,'missing_before_freeze':['applicable_minimum_use_terms','traceable_authorized_local_sample','auditable_remaining_budget','bound_receipt_and_evaluator_verifier']},ensure_ascii=True,indent=2))
